coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable items (43%): the two baseline prompts, the 23-task BBH set, and per-task accuracy comparisons against baselines. The per-task comparison match is incomplete because the expected improvement threshold is omitted.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The model configuration offers alternatives rather than specifying PaLM 2-L-IT as optimizer and text-bison as scorer. The proposed sample counts do not match the required 20% optimization/80% testing split. An empty instruction is included as a baseline but not specified as the optimization starting point. Final training accuracy relative to baselines is not measured explicitly; evaluation focuses on held-out accuracy. The expected >5% improvement in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks is missing.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on most tasks.
